document.title: Keep a cross-layer contract large
document.summary: The size rule now calls a contract that the checks, the UI, and the instructions all use large, even when those layers share fewer groups.
document.why: [The eval on main](source:s1) failed because comprehende-47 was medium. The hand-written outcome for that case says large.

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 26
sources.gist: Eval run 36224503332 failed only on comprehende-47 size: expected large or very-large, got medium, with 4 groups.

groups.title: Size rule for a cross-layer contract
groups.why: [The producer](source:s1) treated four groups as medium. The same change with six groups was large.
groups.summary: `skills-next` says that contract is large, and the `.agents` copy is identical.

commits.subject: Skill: a cross-layer contract stays large when groups merge
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Size was optional ("can be large") and tied to a three-file example, so a sources contract plus its checks, UI, and skill landed on medium whenever the producer merged those layers into four groups.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
